name: Tomodachi Kankin Gakkou
source:
The protagonist, who likes solitude and has no friends, seeks a space for himself and enters an old school building that suddenly appears before his eyes. Once inside, he is unable to leave the place unless he becomes friends with the girl inside.

This is the story of the "protagonist who doesn't need friends" and the "girl who wants friends."
translation:
喜欢独处、没有朋友的主人公，为自己寻找一片空间，走进了突然出现在眼前的一栋旧校舍。一旦进去，他就无法离开这个地方，除非他与里面的女孩成为朋友。

这是“不需要朋友的主角”和“想要朋友的女孩”的故事。
